high_level_description: This image appears to be a promotional poster for a Tamil film titled "Aadu Poochiru Thappu." The poster features three men prominently displayed against a vibrant background with a mix of blue, yellow, and purple hues. People: The top left corner shows a man with a mustache and a traditional forehead marking (tilak), wearing a sleeveless shirt. He is smiling and has his hand near his mouth. The top right corner depicts another man with short hair, sunglasses, and a beard, wearing a white shirt. He is raising both hands in a celebratory gesture
